title: How to stop AI hallucinations and fact-check what AI writes
seoTitle: How to stop AI hallucinations in your work
description: Why AI hallucinations happen, in plain words, and how to stop them. Give sources, ask for citations and MISSING markers, then fact-check with one list.
lede: AI hallucinations are confident answers that are wrong, and they happen most when your AI is asked for a fact it doesn't have. This guide explains why, then gives you three prompts and a checklist that make made-up facts rare and easy to catch.
keywords: how to stop ChatGPT making things up
why does AI make things up
